from hermes_tools import write_file, terminal
content='''def transform(grid):
    # Move the non-background object adjacent to the full-width divider.
    # Preserve the object shape, then mark its far edge with color 8.
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=g[0][0]
    divider=next(r for r,row in enumerate(g) if all(v==row[0] for v in row) and row[0]!=bg)
    divcolor=g[divider][0]
    # find non-background components other than the divider
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg and not (r==divider and g[r][c]==divcolor)]
    # object bounds; translate toward divider, preserving its side
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    obj=[[g[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    # remove object
    for r,c in pts: g[r][c]=bg
    if r0>divider:
        nr0=divider+1
        for i,row in enumerate(obj): g[nr0+i][c0:c1+1]=row
        mark=nr0+len(obj)
    else:
        nr1=divider-1
        nr0=nr1-len(obj)+1
        for i,row in enumerate(obj): g[nr0+i][c0:c1+1]=row
        mark=nr0-1
    if 0<=mark<h: g[mark]=[8]*w
    return g
'''
